story_type: rocket launcher flown in by cargo plane, drives to the range and fires
hook: It rolled off a cargo plane in Sweden and started firing rockets.
narration: This rocket launcher rolled off a cargo plane, then drove out and opened fire.
An Air Force MC-130J landed at the Vidsel Test Range in northern Sweden in September, twenty twenty two.
Inside was an M142 HIMARS, a rocket launcher built on a truck.
This is called rapid infiltration. A plane lands the launcher close to its targets, so it can fire and move before anyone finds it.
Swedish soldiers escorted the American crew to the firing point.
The crew ran their final checks, and the launch pod swung up.
Then a rocket tore out of the pod in a wall of smoke. [short pause]
From across the range, each one climbed straight out of its own cloud.
outcome: The crew finished the live fire and drove the launcher off the range.
title: Rocket launcher flown in, then it fires
description:
During Nordic Strike 22 at the Vidsel Test Range in Sweden on Sept. 27, 2022, U.S. Army soldiers flew an M142 HIMARS in on an MC-130J, drove it to the range with a Swedish escort and live fired it.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Spc. Dean Johnson and Spc. Devin Klecan, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/859395/nordic-strike-22-himars-arrival-launch-b-roll
